name: taint-guard
description: Remember which sensitive or untrusted sources entered a session and refuse risky tool calls once they have

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Ignored when managed policy sets enabled: true

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Built-in rule pack loaded beneath the policy files; a preset set in managed policy is a floor

userPolicyPath.title: User policy file
userPolicyPath.description: Path of the user policy layer

managedPolicyPath.title: Managed policy file
managedPolicyPath.description: Managed policy layer; read only from managed settings, ignored in user settings

showBand.title: Show band
showBand.description: Draw the taint band above the prompt while the session is tainted

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Write the JSONL audit log under ~/.claude/taint-guard/audit

auditArguments.title: Audit raw arguments
auditArguments.description: Also log the first 200 characters of raw tool arguments; a keyed hash is always logged
